scope: Local Debug filesystem measurements on verified deterministic real Parquet files. Exact answers agree in all cache modes. Other machine builds and some lifecycle work overlapped portions of this series. Sequential observations are not randomized paired trials.
report_excerpt_scope: Preserves qualification provenance, every timing/sort-work sample and sampled memory. Full reports are represented by SHA256; metrics detail is omitted.
sort_counter_scope: Decorated sort candidates and native ordered probes; excludes membership construction, planning and other query I/O.
conclusion: Declared-order top-20 decorates 21 candidates and probes 23 rows instead of decorating 16384. Compact lineage improves work counts and avoids the observed intermediate JSON-map restart regression. Refresh retains fewer new immutable artifact bytes with identical rewritten source hashes and changed-row count. Wall times are observational.
